name: Vector Pipeline 2028 Westbound Expansion

values.DataCenterNotes: No single data center campus or tenant is named for this project. A federal Energy Information Administration workbook from August 2026 says the Vector expansion serves power and data centers in the Chicago market, and says it is driven by coal plant retirements plus data center load. Enbridge and DT Midstream sanctioned the added 400 million cubic feet per day of westbound capacity in May 2026, with service in 2028. An Enbridge story from May 2026 says the capacity is backed by 20 year contracts with investment-grade utilities and describes it as serving utility demand growth. That story does not mention data centers. The utility shippers are not named.

researcher_notes: Enbridge and DT Midstream sanctioned an added 400 million cubic feet per day of westbound capacity on Vector, with service in 2028 (Enbridge story, May 2026). The EIA August 2026 workbook, sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 131, lists the project as Vector Pipeline Expansion, status Applied, 400 MMcf/d, 2028. It is not an existing row. The parent Vector Gas Pipeline (P0277) is operating, and the Blue Water rows (P2505, P3202) are older, separate projects. Guardian (P8171) is a different pipeline. Length is not stated anywhere found. EIA leaves it blank and the scope is likely compression plus loops, so length and diameter are left blank until a filing gives them. No FERC filing for the Vector expansion was located. Status is proposed because it is not yet built. DataCenter is yes from the EIA August 2026 workbook (Natural Gas Pipeline Projects sheet, Excel row 131). Its Demand Served column for this project says "Power / data centers (Chicago market)", and its notes say the expansion is driven by coal plant retirements plus data center load. That is a statement about this project, the same basis used for the Crossroads expansion. No data center campus or shipper is named, so the tag is medium confidence. Enbridge says the capacity serves utility demand. The 2028 year is the target in-service year, so it goes in StartYear1, not ProposalYear. The Natural Gas Intelligence article could not be read for the data center claim. Owner is the Vector Pipeline partnership, 60 percent Enbridge and 40 percent DT Midstream per Enbridge. The legal form LP is from the sponsor name in the queue and was not checked in a registry. Medium confidence: two sources agree on size and timing, none gives route or length.
